event:
user: I dislike staying at chain hotels; I prefer unique, independently owned properties.
assistant:  I understand that you prefer to stay in independent, unique hotels rather than chain hotels. Here are a few ways to find and book these types of properties:

1. Use hotel booking websites that specialize in independent properties, such as:
* [Boutique Hotels](https://www.boutique-hotels.com/)
* [Mr & Mrs Smith](https://www.mrandmrssmith.com/)
* [Design Hotels](https://www.designhotels.com/)
* [Independent Collection](https://www.independentcollection.com/)
2. Check out [Boutique and Lifestyle Lodging Association](https://blla.org/) (BLLA) for a list of independent hotels and boutique properties.
3. Use [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/) or [Expedia](https://www.expedia.com/) and filter for "independent" or "boutique" hotels.
4. Look for local hotel associations or tourism boards in your destination, which often promote independent properties.
